captions.detailed: An adjustable decline workout bench featuring a long back pad, an articulated seat, and a front leg-roller assembly. The entire frame is rendered in a dark matte finish, with a low wheel set at the rear end for portability. The back pad and seat are mounted on distinct horizontal hinges allowing rotational adjustment, while the front leg rollers and rear transport wheels rotate on their respective axles.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an adjustable decline workout bench. Include a structural metal frame with a low rear wheel set, a folding mid-frame brace under the seat, a long back pad, an articulated seat, and a front leg-roller assembly, ensuring all components are connected by appropriate rotational joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining a base frame with transport wheels and structural supports using box and cylinder primitives. It then adds a series of articulated parts, including a back pad and seat pad modeled as boxes, a leg roller assembly modeled with cylindrical pads on a crossbar, and a folding mid-frame brace. These parts are connected using revolute and continuous articulations to enable realistic rotation of the backrest, seat, leg rollers, brace, and transport wheels.
